numbering.reasonFor031A: MO-MVP-TASK-031 is already reserved in the historical Task Index for Jurisdiction Recommendation

direction.summary: Turn exact governed work outcomes into private Capability observations, append-oriented Ledger evidence, explainable Reflection Candidates, explicit subject-user dispositions and deterministic private Capability Profile/Twin projections without automatic verification, Canon mutation or public ranking.

decisionAlternatives.reason: Milestone 5 deliberately deferred Capability learning until reviewed lifecycle outcomes existed; those governed sources now exist and the Product Lock still requires the Capability learning Beta loop.
Finance remains separate from Capability evidence, performance, authority and completion.
External filing and Official Truth require separate protected-action, credential and official-source architecture.
Private Capability reflection semantics and privacy must be proven before any public ranking, rating or marketplace product is considered.
The M6 Capability Twin is a private read model and receives no independent action or permission authority.
M6 closes the Capability learning loop only; Content Studio and Opportunity Center expansion remain separately bounded work.

semanticBoundaries.capabilityCanon: accepted canonical Capability semantics and version lineage; runtime work evidence cannot mutate it automatically
semanticBoundaries.runtimeCapabilityDefinition: Capability Engine-owned durable operational projection of one exact accepted Canon identity/version
semanticBoundaries.capabilityObservation: private exact source-linked observation of governed work exposure/participation; not proficiency or qualification truth
semanticBoundaries.capabilityLedgerEntry: Capability Engine-owned append-oriented private evidence history; not canonical Capability truth
semanticBoundaries.reflectionCandidate: private explainable candidate; not canonical truth and not verified Capability
semanticBoundaries.reflectionDisposition: explicit authenticated subject-user decision over one exact candidate version
semanticBoundaries.capabilityProfile: private deterministic projection from accepted reflection/ledger state; not certification or public score
semanticBoundaries.capabilityTwin: private Capability-focused projection; not autonomous identity, agent, professional appointment or permission source
semanticBoundaries.providerSupplyCapability: MGSN provider-network truth; never direct user Capability evidence
semanticBoundaries.providerReturn: MGSN provider assertion/evidence; never direct user Capability evidence

load one exact accepted runtime Capability definition/version
load one exact governed Execution/MarkReg reviewed work source
admit one exact Capability Observation without caller-controlled subject identity
persist one append-oriented private Capability Ledger entry
generate one explainable private Reflection Candidate with exact provenance
record one explicit ACCEPTED subject-user disposition
rebuild one deterministic private Capability Profile and Twin projection
render the private Capability Center through Gateway and Lite
restart runtimes and replay exact admission/disposition without duplicate business state
deny raw Provider Return and Provider Supply Capability as direct user Capability evidence
prove verification, Canon mutation, public ranking, permission escalation, finance, legal appointment, filing and Official Truth consequences remain false
